info.title: THBS Field Assist API
info.description: Synthetic demo service. Cookie mutations require an exact allowed Origin. IDs and cursors are UUIDs. Lists order by creation/receipt timestamp descending, then ID. Optional dashboard AI endpoints call OpenAI on demand with scoped text only; mobile offline inference is unchanged. AI has no write tools, stores API responses with store:false, validates source IDs, caches matching answers for five minutes, and enforces six attempts per user per five minutes plus 100 per workspace per UTC day. The server key is never returned to clients. Dashboard RBAC: ADMIN manages accounts and all operations; OPERATIONS_MANAGER assigns jobs and reviews reports; TEMPLATE_MANAGER manages forms/types and reads engineer/device directories; VIEWER reads operational summaries, reports, jobs and assets. TEAM_LEAD is restricted to led squads; SALES can route clients and assign client-linked squad jobs without report evidence; ENGINEER can sign in to mobile and a dashboard restricted to own jobs, clients, reports and assets. All roles can message active organisation colleagues; private conversations require participation. New jobs require engineer acceptance before a linked report is uploaded. Existing pre-feature jobs retain legacy acceptance. Team leads can create named squad project boards. Profile avatars are selected from a local catalogue. Engineer site check-in, breaks and check-out are immutable ordered actions with stable request IDs; one active visit per engineer, foreground arrival/departure location, device action timestamps and separate server receipt timestamps. Time visibility is limited to the engineer, responsible leads and permitted operational roles. No continuous tracking or closed-app push is claimed. Assignment responses retain their original brief and reports retain their assignment generation. Account changes are audited; pause/removal and credential changes revoke online sessions. Already-offline clients remain bounded by their existing signed lease.
